items.context: oh it's actually pretty unfamiliar with the steam deck family, it had no idea there was such a difference... would you say the oled model is the one to get?
items.text: The OLED model has a nicer screen and a bigger battery than the original LCD one. Check the current price and storage options on Steam's Deck page before deciding.

items.author: wisely.bsky.social
items.context: Just finished a game of Stellaris - something I rarely do: either it becomes a slog, an update breaks my save, or I enrage a FE too soon. Kind of disappointed in the end screen - I'd expect at least a little fanfare?! Nope just - Your empire in 1st (or whatever) place and Quit/Continue buttons...
items.text: Finishing a full Stellaris game is an achievement on its own. Hope the next campaign makes it to the end screen without any drama.
